Onion Farmers Seek Rs 3,000/Quintal Amid Surplus Fears

Onion farmers are demanding government measures to ensure a price of Rs 3,000 per quintal, citing fears of a surplus in production. The demand comes as farmers anticipate a large yield, which could potentially drive down market prices.
